facts.business: Shivam Autotech Limited is an automotive component manufacturer diversifying into industrial components, renewable energy equipment components, power sector components, construction tool components, and railways.

guidance_or_targets.statement: Priorities for FY2026-27: restoring profitable growth, improving operational performance, improving asset utilisation, strengthening cash generation, reducing leverage, expanding presence in high-growth product categories and delivering sustainable value for all stakeholders.

auditor.name: Not explicitly stated in excerpts
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Fund raised on short-term basis to the extent of Rs 3,325.87 Lakhs have been used for long term purposes mainly due to losses in earlier years. Cash losses of Rs 3,501.99 lakhs in current financial year and Rs 567.56 lakhs in previous financial year. Idle/surplus funds amounting to Rs 1,873.65 lakhs from debenture proceeds not required for immediate use.

key_risks: Constrained liquidity and limited working capital availability
Geopolitical conflicts, evolving trade policies, supply chain disruptions and commodity price volatility
Higher raw material and tooling costs, longer procurement cycles
Inflationary pressures on power and manpower costs
Implementation of revised wage code increasing operating cost base
Fund raised on short-term basis used for long term purposes
Cash losses in current and previous financial years
Quantitative variance between physical and book records of inventory due to non-updation of BOM
facts.related_party_note: All contracts/arrangements/transactions entered by the Company during the financial year with related parties were in the ordinary course of business and on arm's length basis and do not attract the provisions of Section 188 of the Companies Act, 2013. No material related party transactions during the year. Suitable disclosure as required by IND AS 24 has been made in the notes to the Financial Statements.
